normalization.method: 5th/95th percentile winsorization followed by direction-aware min-max scaling

raw_matrix.join_policy: architecture identity; evidence remains unqualified unless physical seed and scenario traceability also match
raw_matrix.row_grain: physical architecture/liberty/seed x workload x interleaving/fault/scrub scenario

score_policy: EPC, ESII, NESII, and GREEN_score remain NOT_QUALIFIED until their full evidence inputs and reference cohort are qualified
